<!-- Why chips are 960 m on a side: one animated figure, stepped with clicks.
     Pixel grids for Sentinel-2 (10 m) and Landsat (30 m) stack up, each is
     cut into 16 × 16 px ViT patches, then four chip sizes are tried: 160, 320
     and 640 m leave Landsat with part-patches; 960 m, the first multiple of
     lcm(160, 480) = 480 m past 640 m, tiles both and gives more context per
     chip than settling for 480 m. The figure is generated: see _grid/ and
     "Grid-alignment figure" in the README. -->

## Why 960 m chips? {#chip-size}

{{< grid-alignment >}}

::: {.footer}
Chip origins are snapped to a 60 m-aligned UTM grid, so one 30 m Landsat pixel covers exactly 3 × 3 Sentinel-2 10 m pixels and the grids nest.
:::
